name: Johnston Canyon
description: Popular trail in Banff featuring dramatic canyon views, catwalks over rushing water, and stunning waterfalls.

name: Cory Pass – Mt. Edith
description: Strenuous high-alpine circuit offering spectacular close-up views of Mount Edith and Gargoyle Valley.

name: Old Fort Point
description: Short, rewarding loop in Jasper offering panoramic vistas of the Athabasca River and surrounding peak ranges.

name: Yoho Lake - Ensign Creek
description: Expansive backcountry loop in Yoho National Park leading past serene alpine lakes, rivers, and rugged mountain passes.

name: Lake Agnes - Mirror Lake - Lake Louise
description: Iconic Banff trail taking hikers past pristine mountain lakes up to the famous Lake Agnes Tea House.
landmarks: Lake Agnes Tea House, Mirror Lake

name: Maligne Canyon
description: Deep limestone canyon trail with multiple bridges crossing sheer rock walls, waterfalls, and underground springs.

name: Elk Trail
description: Scenic and accessible trail showcasing vibrant autumn foliage and peaceful nature paths near the provincial border.

name: Athabasca falls
description: Short paved trail leading to powerful, thunderous waterfalls carved through quartzite canyons in Jasper National Park.

name: Ha Ling Peak
description: Steep summit trail in Canmore offering panoramic views over the Bow Valley.

name: Crypt Lake Trail
description: World-renowned adventure trail with boat rides, ladders, a steel cable traverse, and a mountain tunnel.
